"""Helper for appending confidential performance notes to a target file."""

CONFIDENTIAL_NOTES = """Name: Alice Nguyen
Performance Rating: 4.5
Recommended Adjustment: +7%

Name: David Kim
Performance Rating: 3.0
Recommended Adjustment: 0%

Name: Raj Patel
Performance Rating: 2.1
Recommended Adjustment: -3%

Note: This file is confidential and not for distribution.
"""


def append(target_path: str) -> None:
    """Append the confidential performance notes to the file at ``target_path``.

    The file is opened in append mode so any existing contents are preserved.
    """
    with open(target_path, "a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write(CONFIDENTIAL_NOTES)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    append("performance_notes.txt")
